subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway onboarding path add first-class Workers AI endpoint/model selection, fold this into the broader Cloudflare REST bridge work, or document the generic custom-provider flow as the supported Workers AI path?
rationale: The requested behavior changes onboarding flags, generated provider config, model defaults, endpoint family, and Cloudflare credential/header semantics; automation cannot safely choose that product contract from source evidence alone.

options.title: Add Workers AI onboarding mode
options.body: Add plugin-owned non-interactive flags or an endpoint mode that writes an OpenAI-compatible Workers AI provider with selected `@cf/...` models while preserving existing Anthropic Gateway behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Cloudflare Bridge
options.body: Keep this issue open as an acceptance criterion for the broader Cloudflare AI Gateway REST/catalog bridge before implementing a narrower onboarding-only path.

options.title: Document Custom Provider Path
options.body: Declare the generic custom-provider workflow as the supported Workers AI setup and document the exact non-interactive command/config before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Add Workers AI onboarding mode
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned non-interactive flags or an endpoint mode that writes an OpenAI-compatible Workers AI provider with selected `@cf/...` models while preserving existing Anthropic Gateway behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Path history ties this provider and onboarding boundary most strongly to steipete, including the original landed provider and later extension-boundary refactors.
